findings.quote: Taking the simple average of the two speeds, (4 + 6)/2 = 5 m/s, instead of weighting by the distance each speed covers.
findings.note: Average speed is total distance over total time, which weights each speed by the TIME spent at it, not by the distance covered. Weighting by distance here would give (4×8 + 6×18)/26 = 5.38 m/s, not the correct 5.2 m/s.
findings.fix: Taking the simple average of the two speeds, (4 + 6)/2 = 5 m/s, instead of weighting each speed by the time spent at it.
